author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: Ternary equality has local mode degree at most two. An explicit bounded-degree tensor-network family and specified valid packing realize every degree-feasible Newton tuple as a complete nonzero child-product summand at the source taper precision; a zero-mode child packet need not be an equality table.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size support, height and global packing arguments
No claim that the source default labeling selects this packing or that these summands cannot be aggregated or simplified
A general recursive invariant and complete cost analysis are required for any SAT speedup
